aa="A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V".split()

idx={c:i for i,c in enumerate(aa)}
Bm=np.array([[int(v) for v in ln.split()] for ln in raw.strip().split("\n")],dtype=np.float64)
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,0) for c in s])
G=10.0
def nwalign(a,b):
    ea,eb=enc(a),enc(b); n,m=len(a),len(b); S=Bm[np.ix_(ea,eb)]
    H=np.empty((n+1,m+1)); H[0]=-G*np.arange(m+1); H[:,0]=-G*np.arange(n+1); j=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        t=np.empty(m+1); t[0]=H[i-1,0]-G
        t[1:]=np.maximum(H[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1],H[i-1,1:]-G)
        H[i]=np.maximum.accumulate(t+G*j)-G*j
    i,k=n,m; A=[];B=[]
    while i>0 and k>0:
        if abs(H[i,k]-(H[i-1,k-1]+S[i-1,k-1]))<1e-9: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append(b[k-1]);i-=1;k-=1
        elif abs(H[i,k]-(H[i-1,k]-G))<1e-9: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append("-");i-=1
        else: A.append("-");B.append(b[k-1]);k-=1
    while i>0: A.append(a[i-1]);B.append("-");i-=1
    while k>0: A.append("-");B.append(b[k-1]);k-=1
    return "".join(A[::-1]),"".join(B[::-1])
def fa(a): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",headers=h,timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
def mnsites(acc):
    j=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",headers=h,timeout=60).json()
    return sorted({f["location"]["start"]["value"] for f in j.get("features",[])
                   if f["type"]=="Binding site" and f.get("ligand",{}).get("name")=="Mn(2+)"})
def mapref(ref,tgt):
    A,B=nwalign(ref,tgt); ri=ti=0; m={}
    for x,y in zip(A,B):
        if x!="-": ri+=1
        if y!="-": ti+=1
        if x!="-" and y!="-": m[ri]=(ti,y)
    return m

Q=fa("A0A855A6N2")                     # C. leptum CH238_05280
refs={"P60651":("E. coli agmatinase, EC 3.5.3.11","measured, PMID 11250212-era SpeB"),
      "Q5SJ85":("T. thermophilus N1-aminopropylagmatine ureohydrolase, EC 3.5.3.24","measured, PMID 15983049")}
rows=[]
for acc,(nm,prov) in refs.items():
    R=fa(acc); sites=mnsites(acc); m=mapref(R,Q)
    for p in sites:
        t=m.get(p)
        rows.append({"reference":acc,"ref_enzyme":nm,"ref_pos":f"{R[p-1]}{p}",
                     "CH238_05280":(f"{t[1]}{t[0]}" if t else "no aligned residue"),
                     "conserved":bool(t and t[1]==R[p-1])})
tab=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("Binuclear Mn(2+) site, UniProt feature table of each reference mapped onto C. leptum CH238_05280")
print(tab.to_string(index=False))
for acc in refs:
    s=tab[tab.reference==acc]; print(f"  {acc}: {s.conserved.sum()}/{len(s)} Mn ligands conserved in CH238_05280")
# do the two reference enzymes differ from each other at the Mn site?
R1,R2=fa("P60651"),fa("Q5SJ85"); m12=mapref(R1,R2); s1=mnsites("P60651")
same=sum(1 for p in s1 if m12.get(p) and m12[p][1]==R1[p-1])
print(f"\nE. coli agmatinase vs T. thermophilus APAUH, the two measured enzymes: {same}/{len(s1)} Mn ligands identical.")
print("The metal site is therefore the same in both activities and carries no substrate information,")
print("the same failure mode as the decarboxylase pocket.")
tab.to_csv("CH238_05280_Mn_site.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,3.6))
lab=[f"{r.reference}\n{r.ref_pos}" for r in tab.itertuples()]
ax.bar(range(len(tab)),[1]*len(tab),color=["#009e73" if c else "#c0392b" for c in tab.conserved])
for k,r in enumerate(tab.itertuples()):
    ax.text(k,.5,r.CH238_05280,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8,color="w",fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(tab))); ax.set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=7)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_ylabel("")
ax.set_title("Mn(2+) ligands of the arginase fold mapped onto C. leptum CH238_05280.\n"
             "Green = identical to the reference. Both measured references, an agmatinase and an\n"
             "aminopropylagmatine ureohydrolase, give the same answer, so the metal site does not assign the gene.",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
